title: Assigning a Permanent Location to an Item
titles: Associating an Item with a Permanent Location
Assigning a Permanent Location to an Item
breadcrumbs: Associating an Item with a Permanent Location

children: Assigning a Permanent Location to an Item

You can associate both inventory and non-inventory items with permanent 
 locations. A permanent location identifies the one location where a specific 
 item/unit of measure is stored. Note that if you want to replenish an 
 item/unit of measure, you must assign 
 it to a permanent location. If you create an item location assignment 
 record and do not associate it with a UM, the system will use it to process 
 any UM not identified on another item location assignment record.

Allocating Inventory 
 Items -  If you want to use the Check Item Location Strategy, associate 
 an inventory tracked item with its permanent location. When that strategy 
 is used, the system will always allocate the item from its permanent location.

Allocating Non-Inventory Items - Since non-inventory tracked
 items must be associated with a permanent location, the system will always 
 attempt to allocate the item from permanent locations only.

Locating Non-Inventory Items - Since non-inventory tracked
 items must be associated with a permanent location, the system will always 
 attempt to locate the item to permanent locations only.

If you have no unit of measure assigned to an item (on the Item Unit of Measure Window), the system will use all units of measure when assigning a permanent location to an item. For example, if you have pallet as the unit of measure, then the system will only assign a permanent location for that unit of measure. If you locate a full pallet, the system would pick that up as a permanent location. However, if you locate a case, it would not. The same is true with allocation, as only full pallet allocation requests would use this as the permanent location.
Note on Creating Permanent Locations That Currently Do Not Exist

When creating/copying a item location assignment record, and  the permanent location you indicate is not a location currently defined in the system, the system will create a  new location record if the following is true:
The inventory control value "Should location be validated throughout  system?" is set to "No"
The location you enter is not a location defined in the location  configuration

The resulting Location Window record will be an "Inventory Storage" location  that is designated as "Empty" and is assigned to the warehouse that you  indicated for the item location assignment record.

Use the Item 
 Field to identify the item that you want to assign to a permanent 
 location.

Use the Company 
 Field to identify the company associated with this item. This field 
 is only displayed if your warehouse supports multi-company processing.

Use the Quantity 
 UM Field to identify the unit of measure that will be stored in 
 this location. If you leave this field blank, the system can associate 
 all of the item's units of measure with this location.

If necessary, 
 change the value in the Warehouse Field.

Use the Permanent 
 Location Field to identify the location that you want to assign 
 to this item.

Press OK. 
 The system will save your changes.
